what: Guitar effects from an FM-1. A guitar, or any sound a computer plays, goes in over USB and comes out of its socket through AISLING's live effects: reverb, shimmer, echo, phaser, drive, crush and more, held by key or CC. Knobs set the filter, sends and dry.
author: CU_STE
sounds: own: the visualiser's demo recording is AISLING itself playing Skellig, rendered from its own code; the firmware uses no samples
